photos.c: Above: Surrey Cross-Country Championships at Epsom, 2nd January 1926. Left to right. Ken O'Kell (Belgrave) 3rd man home, W.T.Dear (Surrey A.C.) 1st, and M.A.Kempton (Ranelagh) 2nd.

share.d: M.A. Kempton in The Belgravian, the Belgrave Harriers club gazette, 1926–1992: 2 mentions in 2 issues, 2 race results and 1 photograph.
